headline: TXOne StellarOne parsing and modeling rules added; Salesforce gains file and Knowledge commands
summary_md:
- **TXOne StellarOne** is a new XSIAM-only pack: parsing and modeling rules for OT endpoint security logs collected over syslog through the Broker VM.
- **Salesforce 2.2.0** added five commands covering file deletion, public links and Knowledge article lifecycle, and made *Credentials* optional for unified-connector instances.
- **Rapid7 InsightVM** no longer times out mid-stream on large `fetch-assets` report downloads.
- A quiet day otherwise: four packs moved in total, with no Docker bump.

highlights.title: TXOne StellarOne logs can now be modeled in XSIAM
highlights.detail: Parsing and modeling rules cover audit, system, console and agent (StellarProtect) events forwarded in CEF, queryable as the txone_stellarone_raw dataset.

highlights.title: Salesforce added Knowledge article archive and draft commands
highlights.detail: salesforce-knowledge-article-archive and salesforce-knowledge-article-draft-create wrap the standard archiveKnowledgeArticles and createDraftFromOnlineKnowledgeArticle actions, the latter unpublishing the online version by default.

highlights.title: Salesforce Credentials became optional for unified-connector instances
highlights.detail: UCP-managed instances resolve the access token at runtime and were being rejected during pre-execution config validation as missing required config values.

highlights.title: Rapid7 InsightVM fetch-assets survives large reports
highlights.detail: The report download stream was cut off after five minutes; it now uses an idle-read timeout with no overall limit, so a large report completes in one run.

highlights.title: ASM stopped offering a remediation it could not perform
highlights.detail: The Cortex ASM - Remediation Path Rules playbook offered *Restrict Open Ports* even when on-prem enrichment had not identified a firewall rule to update.

items.Packs/TXOneStellarOne: New XSIAM pack: parsing and modeling rules for TXOne StellarOne OT endpoint audit, system, console and agent logs ingested via the Broker VM as txone_stellarone_raw.
items.Packs/Salesforce: 2.2.0 added file delete, public link list and remove, and Knowledge article archive and draft-create commands; the Credentials parameter is now optional.
items.Packs/Rapid7_Nexpose: Fixed fetch-assets failing on large reports after a five-minute stream cutoff, added the underlying error type to streaming failure messages, and logged received line counts.
items.Packs/CortexAttackSurfaceManagement: Cortex ASM - Remediation Path Rules no longer offers Restrict Open Ports when on-prem enrichment did not identify a firewall rule to update.
